scope: V51 candidate only; does not resolve frozen V19 findings

findings.disposition: Permanent custody retained; destination guards added. Human verification and holder disclosure remain required.
Regulated records now require local chain ID.
Asset identity is append-only; enable/disable is separate and evented.
NFT existence enforced for vault creation, deposits, entitlement records and snapshots.
Dead-address transfer is not ERC20 totalSupply reduction; disclosure retained.
